prompt: A single illustration shows a person closing a laptop and walking away while, high above, a glowing cloud server remains active like a small floating workshop. Inside the cloud, an abstract AI agent continues sorting tasks, watching notification streams, and assembling a long-running project across day and night cycles. Small icons show monitored events, progress bars, and unfinished work being steadily completed, while a gentle line returns the finished results to the user’s device when they come back, making clear that the agent keeps operating independently on a remote server even when the user’s own computer is off.
